{{Top|leg}}
[[File:Performer_FH.png|thumb|right|250px|A male Lethan Twi'lek acrobat named Malisan]]
{{Quote|And, to amaze and amuse you with feats of gymnastics and spellbinding acrobatics, Atuarre presents her pet prodigy, Pakka!|Atuarre|<ref name="Han Solo at Stars' End">''[[Han Solo at Stars' End]]''</ref>}}
An '''acrobat''', '''tumbler'''<ref name="RPG-Core">''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game Core Rulebook]]''</ref>, or '''gymnast'''<ref name="COO">''[[Choices of One]]''</ref> was a type of [[Entertainer|performer]] who entertained audiences through feats of gymnastics skill and agility. Due to their natural dexterity, members of the [[Gados]] [[Species/Legends|species]] made excellent acrobats. For instance, the [[Leaping Tee]] family toured [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] as a acrobat troupe.<ref name="CATCW ">''[[Coruscant and the Core Worlds]]''</ref> Due to their natural [[Hive mind/Legends|communal intelligence]] and ability to work together flawlessly, groups of [[Bilar]]s made excellent acrobats as well.<ref name="GG4b 21">[[Galaxy Guide 4: Alien Races (Second Edition)|''Galaxy Guide 4: Alien Races'', Second Edition]]</ref> During the reign of the [[Galactic Empire]], there was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Lethan/Legends|Lethan]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] named [[Malisan]] who performed as an acrobat.<ref name="Far Horizons">''[[Far Horizons]]''</ref> Certain [[Droid/Legends|droids]], known as [[acrobat droid]]s, also entertained through acrobatics.<ref name="E">''[[Legacy of the Force: Exile]]''.</ref>
